'''Nab H'aas''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] during the height of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. H'aas represented his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]], and was a witness to the argument between [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], along with fellow Bith Senator [[Ph'Olla]] regarding the security of [[Ben Skywalker]]. [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lon Shevu]] received H'aas testimony of the event during the investigation into Mara's [[Death/Legends|death]].
